title: E0093: Template Injection
plain_english: Rendering user-controlled input directly as a template source (Twig, Smarty, Blade, etc.) without validation can allow an attacker to inject template expressions that execute code on the server.
why_matters: Server-side template injection (SSTI) can lead to: - Remote code execution - Reading sensitive files (for example `/etc/passwd`) - Full server compromise
what_it_checks: `Twig::render()`, `$twig->render()`, `$smarty->display()`, `$blade->render()`, and similar calls with tainted template names or sources
Template engines rendering user-controlled strings as template source
